material_findings.title: Transient reward masks live placement information
evidence: input_360x800.png visibly places +1 reward over first board row
puzzle_screen.gd:493 places ordinary reward at score_rect.end.y while board starts only 8 px lower
puzzle_screen.gd:576 hides hint for 0.6–1.15 s; a new drag can start after 0.14/0.28 s and _pointer does not dismiss the toast
material_findings.impact: Fast successive play sees a reward over target cells and loses valid/invalid placement guidance during the next drag.
material_findings.correction: Place ordinary placement reward outside board, e.g. replace the hint strip briefly; dismiss any reward on successful pickup and immediately show live placement guidance.
material_findings.acceptance: Capture ordinary placement reward outside board; start valid and invalid drags during prior reward lifetime and verify hints visible, reward dismissed, exactly one commit.

material_findings.title: Compact layout clips clear action once safe insets are present
evidence: basic_320x568.png clear target occupies y512–560 with no insets
puzzle_screen.gd:224–246 accounts for insets in compact choice and top offset but fixed compact heights still require 552 px
At 320×568, clear bottom=560+topInset; usable bottom=568−bottomInset. Total safe insets greater than8 clip target.
material_findings.impact: On a compact Android viewport with system bar/cutout reservation, the manual clear target can cross the usable bottom edge.
material_findings.correction: Derive compact spacing and tray from usable height while retaining 296 px board at320 width and >=48 logical px actionable targets; apply safe top/bottom budget.
material_findings.acceptance: Verify 320×568 with top24/bottom24 inset simulation and native safe-area geometry; assert complete clear target stays inside usable content. Capture compact after correction.
